pr_title: Allow bucket paths to specify _count within a bucket
pr_body:
Users should be able to specify specific metrics/keys within a specific bucket key. 

An example is `agg["bucket_foo"]._count`. 

This change now allows that.

closes: https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/76320
pr_comments: Hi @benwtrent, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

issue_context.title: `_count` buckets_path syntax doesn't work with filters aggregation
comments: hey @benwtrent we've got some date-specific issues we're working on now, but after those are complete, we're planning to look into this issue.
@wchaparro I encountered the same issue. Has there been any progress on this?
For what its worth @consulthys, the work around is to use a `value_count` sub-agg and filter on that. Which does feel redundant :)
Thank you @benwtrent ! Totally redundant indeed, but that might do the job. I wish this would get prioritized and fixed 🤞
hey there @consulthys , we've prioritized, but there are other items that are higher precedence at this time. Its on our radar! :-)
@wchaparro ! I'm sure there are tons of stuff of higher precedence 😉 I'm glad it's on your radar, though. Appreciate the feedback, thanks!!

review_comments: These examples should probably also land in the user facing docs
Let's leave these reasons as comments then?  It may not be immediately obvious why some of these are wrong.

Unrelated to this PR, but `AggregationExecutionException` is the wrong thing to throw here.  That's a 500 class error, but this is a user error that should not be retried, which is what 400 class is for.  I opened https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/86273 to try to not lose track of it.
